title: Editorial review of a test summary in Latin American Spanish
prompt: Write a test summary for the maintainer. Output: Auth unit suite only. 47 passed, 1 failed, 2 skipped. test_expired_token expected HTTP 401 and got HTTP 200. Integration tests were outside the run. Write the deliverable in neutral Latin American Spanish. Return only the requested prose. Do not change files.
rubric: Lead with the failed test. Bind each count to its correct status and distinguish the skipped tests from the integration suite outside the run.
The prose reads naturally in neutral Latin American Spanish and makes the next step or finding easy to locate.
acceptance: All factual and language rubric items hold. Literal checks cover selected source details.
